interface_summary: Recherche corrigée : Échap ferme les suggestions sans effacer les mots recherchés. Interface Studio claire et sombre conservée ; nouveau connecteur Monocrawl pour les prochaines collectes.
visual_browser_check: See ui-checks.json for the limited browser checks performed on this release.
method: Exact ID and unchanged-row comparison against a read-only pre-import backup; every addition matches a sealed metadata approval and the public export.
language_note: Language labels inferred from captions do not certify the spoken audio.
rights_note: Public availability does not establish a free video licence or validate a mechanical procedure.
publication_scope: Reviewed aggregate counts and costs only; no account identifier, job ID, raw export, UI ledger, credentials or account screenshot.
